output.subject: PO HH-PO-552: advance request
output.body:
Hello Harbor and Hearth team,

Thank you for your PO HH-PO-552 for $10,000; we're glad to be working on this order for you. Would you be open to paying a 40% advance on this PO by Nov 23? It would help us keep everything on schedule for your order.

If that timing doesn't work, please let me know what would suit you and we can find an arrangement together.

Thank you,
Cascade Trade Co.
